messages:
Ava (Product): Quick sync — we need to pick a winner for the next sprint: Customer X private pilot (HSM + reserved capacity + SLA) OR full Optimize push (adaptive batching, quant recommendations). Both can’t land this cycle. Input: customer commitment (pilot start in 6 weeks) vs. Optimize long-term cost wins.
Marcus (Eng): Do we have concrete launch criteria for the pilot? I want measurable gates.
Ava (Product): Minimal launch criteria I’m proposing: 1) pilot traffic served from Dedicated pool, 2) p95 latency <= 200ms for 1k rps synthetic, 3) security sign-off (HSM/KMS + audit logs), 4) model version pinned + rollback path.
Lina (Runtime Eng): Runtime constraints: to hit 200ms p95 we need adaptive batching changes + prefix KV warmup for the tenant. Canary requires 2 GPUs (one canary, one baseline) for 48h. Also need model quant profile validated — if we ship quantized weights they must be verified against our eval prompts.
Ravi (Infra PM): Provisioning note: dedicated pool request has ~3 week lead time to reserve capacity in the requested region. Autoscale webhooks + quota wiring to billing need one more API (we can stub for canary, but prod needs proper hook).
Sofia (Security): HSM integration checklist: key provisioning, rotation, attestation logs, and end-to-end audit event stream. We need an acceptance test that demonstrates key rotate without failing decrypts. ETA: ~2 weeks after infra preflight. Also need an SLA dataflow diagram for compliance.
oncall-bot: reminder: "Provisioning request template" link https://intra/redwood/provisioning-template
Marcus (Eng): So blockers: infra lead time (3w), security preflight (2w post-infra), runtime validation (quant+batching). If we target pilot in 6w, timeline is tight but doable if we cut scope.
Ava (Product): Proposal: prioritize Customer X pilot; defer full Optimize rollout. Cut optional telemetry dashboard and advanced visualizer; keep core Optimize tuning (adaptive batching) that directly affects latency/cost. That reduces work for Runtime by ~30%.
Lina (Runtime Eng): Sounds reasonable. With that cut we can focus on: 1) adaptive batching flags behind a feature toggle, 2) KV warmup script for tenant prefixes, 3) quick quant smoke tests against eval set. Canary plan ready once infra has GPUs.
Ravi (Infra PM): I'll start the dedicated pool request today and mark it urgent. ETA: submit by EOD, expected approval in 48-72h, then ~3w for capacity. I can also expose a temporary autoscale stub for canary within 1 week.
Sofia (Security): I’ll prep the HSM acceptance test. Can you attach the dataflow diagram, @Ava? Need it by tomorrow to avoid blocking.
Ava (Product): Uploading diagram now — https://intra/redwood/diagrams/customerX-dataflow.svg 
Marcus (Eng): Quick checklist for this thread (will own):
```
- Owner: Marcus (Eng) — runtime changes
- Infra owner: Ravi (Infra PM) — pool + autoscale stub
- Security owner: Sofia — HSM acceptance + audit
- PM: Ava (Product) — customer comms + acceptance criteria
- Canary window: 48h on dedicated canary GPU
- Launch criteria: p95 <= 200ms, security sign-off, rollback tested
```
Ava (Product): Decision: prioritize Customer X pilot, defer noncritical Optimize features. Roadmap updated. Marcus: commit to initial runtime PR by Tue EOD?
Marcus (Eng): I’ll get the PR up Tuesday EOD. Will include toggle + smoke tests.
Lina (Runtime Eng): I’ll prep the KV warmup script and quant smoke harness — target Wed.
Ravi (Infra PM): Submitted pool request. Tracking ticket #INF-4621. Will update ETA in the ticket.
Sofia (Security): I’ll schedule the HSM preflight review and post the acceptance checklist in INF-4621.
Ava (Product): Great — I’ll notify Customer X that pilot is prioritized and share the acceptance criteria + tentative windows. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
